content: Human-labeling session — econ-harvester-defense-raid:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a harvester-defense drill. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Power Plant (powr) and Ore Refinery (proc) in the north-west corner, one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) auto-cycling to an off-axis ore patch at (30,28), and two medium tanks (2tnk) parked at the refinery on HOLD-FIRE stance. A vertical water wall at x=46..54 splits the map; the only crossing is a 4-cell corridor at y=18..21. At tick 600 an enemy heavy tank spawns east of the wall and drives for your harvester through that corridor. Within about 35 turns, finish with cash at least $1200 and keep your harvester and refinery alive.
